catalyst.facts_line: 2026-12-10 (Thursday), 82 days out -- from the earnings calendar, consensus EPS 1.89.
catalyst.why: Report must show cloud backlog converting to revenue and EPS beating 1.89, confirming AI demand is reaching the income statement.

reasons: Because Oracle's $300B OpenAI backlog converts to recognized revenue over coming quarters, EPS will rise, leading the market to re-rate the stock from 13.4x next-FY EPS.

Because analysts have raised EPS estimates four times in 30 days (from $8.05 to $8.14) after four consecutive beats, they are still catching up, so further upward revisions will push the stock higher.

Because 78% of enterprises plan to raise AI infrastructure spending by 25%+ in 2026, Oracle's cloud revenue growth will accelerate from 30% y/y toward the 49.5% AI spending growth, lifting future earnings.
